patterns.name: POJO / JavaBean to Data Class
patterns.javaPattern: public class User { private String id; public String getId() { return id; } public void setId(String id) { this.id = id; } }
patterns.kotlinPattern: data class User(var id: String? = null)
patterns.description: Replaces verbose Java POJOs containing getters, setters, equals, hashCode, and toString with concise Kotlin data classes.

patterns.name: Null Check to Safe Call & Elvis Operator
patterns.javaPattern: if (user != null && user.getName() != null) { return user.getName(); } else { return "default"; }
patterns.description: Converts conditional null checks and defensive guards into idiomatic Kotlin safe calls (?.) and Elvis operator (?:).

patterns.name: Static Utility Class to Object / Top-Level Function
patterns.javaPattern: public class StringUtils { public static boolean isEmpty(String s) { return s == null || s.trim().isEmpty(); } }
patterns.description: Transforms Java static utility classes into Kotlin objects or top-level extension functions.

patterns.name: StringBuilder to String Templates
patterns.description: Replaces imperative StringBuilder concatenations with Kotlin string interpolation templates.

patterns.name: Imperative Loop to Collection Operations
patterns.javaPattern: List<User> adults = new ArrayList<>(); for (User u : users) { if (u.getAge() >= 18) { adults.add(u); } }
patterns.description: Replaces Java for-each filtering/mapping loops with functional Kotlin collection operations like filter, map, and find.

patterns.name: Anonymous Inner Class to SAM Lambda
patterns.javaPattern: button.setOnClickListener(new View.OnClickListener() { @Override public void onClick(View v) { doSomething(); } });
patterns.description: Converts single-method anonymous inner classes and listeners into concise trailing Kotlin lambdas.

patterns.name: AsyncTask / Thread Execution to Kotlin Coroutines
patterns.javaPattern: new AsyncTask<Void, Void, String>() { protected String doInBackground(Void... p) { return fetchData(); } }.execute();
patterns.description: Replaces legacy Android AsyncTask or background threads with structured Kotlin Coroutines and suspend functions.

patterns.name: Callback Interface to Suspending Function
patterns.javaPattern: public interface DataCallback { void onSuccess(Data data); void onError(Exception e); }
patterns.description: Transforms asynchronous callback listeners into direct sequential suspending functions.

patterns.name: Android XML Layout to Jetpack Compose UI
patterns.kotlinPattern: @Composable fun Screen() { Column { Text("Title"); Button(onClick = {}) { Text("Submit") } } }
patterns.description: Migrates imperative Android XML layout definitions to declarative Jetpack Compose composable components.

patterns.name: Try-With-Resources to .use Extension
patterns.javaPattern: try (BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new FileReader(file))) { return br.readLine(); }
patterns.description: Replaces Java 7 try-with-resources blocks with Kotlin's auto-closing .use {} extension.

patterns.name: Singleton Boilerplate to Object Declaration
patterns.javaPattern: public class Manager { private static Manager instance; public static synchronized Manager getInstance() { ... } }
patterns.description: Replaces double-checked locking singleton boilerplate with Kotlin first-class object declarations.

patterns.name: Switch Statement to When Expression
patterns.javaPattern: switch (status) { case SUCCESS: return 1; case ERROR: return 0; default: return -1; }
patterns.description: Converts Java switch statements into exhaustive, expression-based Kotlin when constructs.

patterns.name: Java Optional to Kotlin Nullable Type
patterns.description: Replaces Java 8 Optional wrappers with native Kotlin nullable types (T?).

patterns.name: Getter/Setter Invocations to Property Access
patterns.description: Replaces getX() and setX() method calls with idiomatic Kotlin synthetic property access syntax.

patterns.name: Constant Interface to Object Const Val
patterns.javaPattern: public interface Constants { public static final String API_URL = "https://api.com"; }
patterns.description: Replaces anti-pattern constant interfaces with Kotlin top-level constants or companion object const val.

patterns.name: Thread.sleep to Coroutine delay
patterns.description: Replaces blocking Thread.sleep calls inside asynchronous scopes with non-blocking coroutine delay().

patterns.name: Explicit ArrayList Instantiation to mutableListOf()
patterns.description: Replaces raw Java collection instantiations with Kotlin stdlib collection factory functions like mutableListOf().

patterns.name: System.out.println to Kotlin println
patterns.description: Replaces verbose System.out.println console logging with Kotlin stdlib top-level println.

patterns.name: Callback Interface / Async Listener to Suspending Function
patterns.javaPattern:
public interface DataCallback<T> { void onSuccess(T result); void onError(Exception e); }
public void loadUserData(String userId, DataCallback<User> callback) { ... }
patterns.kotlinPattern: suspend fun loadUserData(userId: String): User = suspendCancellableCoroutine { continuation -> ... }
patterns.description: Transforms asynchronous callback listeners (onSuccess/onError) and Runnable thread patterns into clean Kotlin suspend functions or Flows.
